reasons: This is a package marker with nothing to test.

terms.meaning: A folder of Python files that can be imported together.
Loading code from another file so it can be used.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package label and version
sections.what: Gives the backend package a one-line description and sets the version to 1.0.0.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the version be read from one place.
sections.watch_out: The version 1.0.0 is also typed in the main app and health check code, so changing only one place causes a mismatch.

summary: Marks the backend folder as a Python package and records its version as 1.0.0.
purpose: Lets other backend files import from this folder and gives one version label.
why: Likely reason: Python needs this file to treat the folder as a package.
how: Python runs this file when the package is first used. It sets the version and the description.
outputs: A version value and a short description.
risks: The same version number is repeated in other files, so they can fall out of step.
debug: If imports from the backend package fail, check that this file exists in the backend folder.
